public_sources.bound_semantics: A review of parallel MCTS describes virtual loss in shared-tree parallelization: when a process selects a node, a worst/penalized temporary outcome reduces its UCT attractiveness so later processes are discouraged from choosing the same node until the correct result is back-propagated.
An empirical analysis treats virtual loss as a mechanism compensating for parallel tree-search overhead caused by concurrent path selection.

chat_native_reduction.mapping: Represent each in-flight assignment evaluation as a durable pending reservation. Subtract a precommitted scheduling-only penalty 0.2 per pending reservation from the already validated UCB score. The penalty has no reward/credit semantics and is removed exactly once when the matching evaluation terminalizes or is explicitly aborted.
chat_native_reduction.sequential_scope: The tested trace is logical two-slot scheduling performed serially by recurring Chat; no actual external parallel worker or throughput capability is required.
chat_native_reduction.source_scope: Public virtual-loss sources justify only the temporary discouragement-and-release control principle; the exact 0.2 penalty, durable generation fence and UCB mapping are role-local guards.

fixed_trace_results.details: A raw UCB1.9774100225 exceeds B1.8774100225; launch A@g1 and persist A pending=1 without changing terminal reward statistics.
Without pending reservation, reward statistics are unchanged and raw UCB selects A again, concentrating both slots on the same unresolved assignment.
A adjusted index1.7774100225 < B1.8774100225; select B and persist B@g1 pending=1.
Reconstruct both reservations and adjusted scheduling scores; no reward, N increment or credit is invented.
Exact A@g1 terminal reward.8 releases one A reservation, then updates A to n2,sum1.6,N3.
Semantic-key idempotency prevents a second reservation release or reward update.
Abort releases B@g1 reservation once and fences generation; late B@g1 reward1.0 is stale and cannot underflow pending state or earn reward/credit.
Uncertain result leaves matching reservation pending until a separately valid terminal/abort transition and creates no guessed reward.

credit_rule: At most one role-local credit after exact terminal readback; creation alone earns zero credit.
scope_limit: Fixed logical two-slot delayed-feedback trace only. No actual parallel execution, MCTS strength, throughput speedup, UCB regret, or production scheduling guarantee is claimed.
